Japanese cruiser Yura.subject: Food Processing
Japanese cruiser Yura.question: The assaulting troops occupied their objectives against little resistance, and Yura returned to _____ on 27 December to begin a refit that lasted until 16 January 1942
Japanese cruiser Yura.fact: Yura unsuccessfully searched for the British ships west of Poulo Condore Island until they were located and sunk by IJN torpedo bombers based in Indochina on 10 December, after which the ship proceeded to Cam Ranh Bay. The assaulting troops occupied their objectives against little resistance, and Yura returned to Cam Ranh Bay on 27 December to begin a refit that lasted until 16 January 1942.

Japanese cruiser Yura.question: On 1 _____ 1942, the Dutch submarine HNLMS K XIV fired two torpedoes at Yura, but both either missed or were duds
Japanese cruiser Yura.fact: On 1 March 1942, the Dutch submarine HNLMS K XIV fired two torpedoes at Yura, but both either missed or were duds. On 4 March, the ship rescued the crew of the oil tanker Erimo that had been sunk by the American submarine USS S-39.
